coverage: ROSTER: the angle names no explicit URLs, so the 'named roster' was its source types (craft essays and writing-advice by novelists, editors and game designers). Discovery: a full crawl of the BrightWeavings sitemap (549 URLs) diffed against the 130 URLs the predecessor finder had already read, plus eight lateral WebSearches; the last two consecutive searches surfaced nothing new. 76 new sources fetched raw by curl with a browser user agent (no summariser, no snippet); 45 substantive, 30 non-substantive (index pages, art pages, video-only pages, student essays, roundups), 1 blocked (justaword.fr, a Medium-hosted interview that returned a 750-byte stub). Per route: bibliography/site-crawl 58 fetched (36 substantive); lateral search 16 fetched (8 substantive); direct named-venue fetch 2. Reddit was unreachable for raw reads (both old.reddit JSON and HTML return the login interstitial to curl), so no reader-forum claims were added this round. GAP: no game designer was found writing about Kay's prose - the only games-adjacent source is an RPGnet forum thread the predecessor already read - and no formal stylometric or corpus study of Kay exists that this sweep could locate. This file carries the predecessor's 120 checkpointed claims plus 163 new ones (283 total across 102 sources); the structured return carries only the 163 new claims.
